title: THE LIVING DESERT
ownership: Journal content and acceptance specification only; engine, assets and saves require parent integration.
coordinates_policy: No real coordinates or private wildlife locality. Existing encounter/map IDs refer only to fictional game habitat sites.

scope.claim: A fully authored short Mojave investigation and statewide story framework; not a complete Mojave district or chapter/campaign.

reward.description: Attach habitat/time captions to journal evidence; no mandatory zoom or score advantage.
Offer the authored oak corridor as the next investigation lead; does not claim D04 completion.
Completes this authored opening investigation only; full Mojave route/art coverage remains a separate release gate.

design_tasks: Choose one completed habitat evidence page per chapter.
Match each caption to its district/habitat; immediate correction permitted.
Compare shelter, water, isolation and climate in ranger conversation.
finale.postgame: Continue exploration and optional guide completion; hidden species discovery is optional and does not block credits.

retry_contract.mandatory_encounters: In correct habitat/time, guaranteed no later than third eligible failed lookup. Existing random repeat lookups need explicit engine override for active mandatory tasks.
retry_contract.rest_hint_visibility: Journal always shows phase and broad habitat; repeat ranger hint available without payment.
retry_contract.photo_quality: Two stars and focused safe distance; perfect three-star photograph never mandatory.
retry_contract.choice_failures: Immediate feedback and unlimited choice retry; no lost progress.
retry_contract.care_recovery: Keep a pending map-name reminder for open rocks. Restoration at original fictional site is always possible.
retry_contract.travel: Existing development expeditions stay usable for test coverage; proposed story-route rewards need shipping progression implementation.

current_engine_limitations: Best album metadata replaces only strictly higher score; use photo event credit independent of best replacement.
Current spot_state restored bit resets at rest; it cannot serve as persistent journal care evidence.
Current engine has no authored ranger/journal UI/task state; all fields in this file require integration.
Use stable native species IDs 0..17 as listed, never guide-number-minus-one from consolidated roster.
event_and_save_contract.prior_save_credit: Seed only demonstrably valid prior best-photo evidence; annotations and sequence-bound care require explicit new actions unless supported persistent evidence exists.
event_and_save_contract.task_credit_before_activation: Allow valid evidence already recorded; do not require redo solely because task dialogue happened later.
event_and_save_contract.bit_budget: 14 task-completion bits plus individually named evidence/annotation/care flags; allocate versioned save schema, do not assume current RFState capacity.

native_acceptance_traces.name: Fresh Mojave opening
ordered_actions: Boot a fresh save; speak to Nell at field camp.
Rest from initial dusk through night to day.
Walk to tortoise burrow encounter 2; use space 3 or 4; hold focus >=45; take 2+ star photo.
Open journal and answer COOL SHELTER; turn in J01_01.
Photograph horned lizard spot3 and chuckwalla spot1 by day, 2+ stars.
Answer SAND / ROCK CRACK; turn in J01_02.
Rest once to dusk; photograph kingsnake at spot0 or6; exit photo and restore that same rock with B.
Answer REPLACE THE ROCK; turn in J01_03.
Rest once to night; photograph toad spot5; restore its rock.
Use expeditions to map2; photograph gecko spot7; annotate RED-SPOTTED TOAD; turn in J01_04.
Restore any open rock before J01_05 turn-in; answer MANY SHELTER TYPES.
Observe Mojave synthesis dialogue and D04 lead; save and cold boot.
expected: J01_01..J01_05 completed and durable
INV_D01_COMPLETE set
C01_COMPLETE remains false until D02,D03,D04 investigation flags
No photo/guide progress erased; no global species quota required
D04 oak lead available; no credits/full-game-complete claim

native_acceptance_traces.name: Annotations teach without punishment
ordered_actions: Meet a photo prerequisite.
Choose each wrong annotation option once.
Check feedback and immediate retry.
Choose correct option.
expected: No photo lost; no penalty or lockout
Annotation flag set only on correct response
Task stays incomplete until all requirements

native_acceptance_traces.name: Rock care binds to the observation
ordered_actions: At dusk photograph kingsnake under spot0.
Leave rock flipped and attempt turn-in.
Restore a different rock; attempt turn-in.
Restore spot0; turn in.
Rest, repeat restoration, revisit journal.
expected: Different-site or absent restoration cannot meet J_CARE_KINGSNAKE_ROCK
Matching restoration meets task requirement once
Repeats do not farm story rewards
Completed journal/care flags survive rest although current spot flags reset

native_acceptance_traces.name: Evidence independent of best-photo replacement
ordered_actions: Before activating task take a valid 3-star subject photo at permitted site/time.
Start relevant task.
Take required valid 2-star photo again and annotate.
Save; cold boot.
expected: Valid prior best may satisfy supported requirements
Equal/lower-scoring new photo emits task evidence even when best album does not replace
No credit for wrong species, map, phase, habitat, or unsafe distance

native_acceptance_traces.name: Bounded recovery
ordered_actions: Trigger scared chuckwalla; hold still; recover without chasing.
Cancel a photo then retry the same site.
Visit mandatory night habitat by day; read rest hint.
Exhaust repeated random-empty attempts in correct phase.
expected: Existing 90-frame hiding recovery remains supported
Cancel loses no earned evidence
At most two phase rests reach any requested time
No more than three eligible failed search attempts before guaranteed mandatory encounter; this guarantee requires engine integration
No wildlife permanently lost

native_acceptance_traces.name: Chapter gating and review boundaries
ordered_actions: Finish only Mojave opening and available D04 optional page.
Visit all ten existing maps.
Open chapter status.
expected: C01 not complete without true D02/D03/D04 full investigation flags
Optional oak page and simple map visitation cannot impersonate district completion
Future unbuilt districts presented as future content rather than accessible empty route
QA expeditions can remain enabled in development; shipping story gating is separately implemented/tested

native_acceptance_traces.name: Optional regional ecology
ordered_actions: Complete each JS side page from legal phase/site/photo input and its annotation.
For island page use daylight; for northern turtle use map5 only.
For high-water page use map8; for oak page use D04, compare optional D09 page separately.
expected: All18 current runtime species obtainable through this authored journal set
Each of21 encounter references matches source-supported permission
None of nine side pages awards full regional investigation completion

native_acceptance_traces.name: Save interruptions
ordered_actions: Save after photo before annotation.
Cold boot; annotate and save.
Cold boot before restoring a photographed flipped rock.
Restore; save; cold boot; turn in.
expected: Evidence, annotation, pending care and task completion persist independently
Reward delivery idempotent on resume
Unknown/newer save remains protected by current save policy

release_gates: Original NPC sprite and journal UI authored and rendered.
Bootable ROM and input-driven traces pass.
